category: premium link generator (free leech of host links)

free_tier.stated: 'Premiumlink - Free Premium Link Generator & File Hosting Leecher ... Get your free, direct download link instantly-no account required.' The page claims '1M+ Links Generated', '50K+ Active Users', '99.9% Uptime' and '100+ Hosts'.
free_tier.notes: The counters are marketing figures with no methodology; no per-file, per-day or speed number is given.

egress.terms: No byte allowance or speed figure published.

interface_detail: A single-page web form. No API, no documented endpoint.
chaining: Interchangeable with any other free leech site no cap means no planning value beyond a one-off fetch.
limits_note: The site's own numbers are popularity counters, not limits. There is no terms or FAQ page to check.
binding_note: No published constraint to bind; the unmeasured reality is the operator's host accounts and server capacity.

identity_cost.detail: 'No registration required-just use, download, and enjoy.'

reliability_note: No operator identity, no terms page and counter-based claims: nothing on the page can be checked if the service stops resolving. Direct probe from this host produced no status at all.
confidence_note: One page read through the broker (which returned a snapshot rather than a live origin body), one probe that produced no HTTP status, and no link generation attempted. Nothing here is measured.

evidence.proved: 'no account required', the 100+ host list (Rapidgator, Nitroflare, Uploaded, Keep2Share, Katfile...), and the 1M+/50K+/99.9% counters
